emma.marketing: flagging a post-webinar anomaly 1 leads (~1.7%) stall between HubSpot and RR when enrichment takes longer than our handshake window. SDRs reported a surge of manual claims.
jamal.ops: thanks. do we have a short trace or an example request id? are leads going to a backfill process? :thinking_face:
emma.marketing: yes. typical flow: HS webhook -> enrichment svc slow (7-12s) -> router TTL=5s -> router routes to BackfillQueue. claim workers only poll RR so they miss these for 20-40m until backfill job moves them.
mike.salesops: to reduce noise, propose a minimal "retry-buffer": HS marks payload with `defer_for_enrich=true` and router keeps lead in a transient buffer for 45s, polling enrichment endpoint every 4-6s. only push to RR when enrich_status=done or after timeout push with enrich_missing flag.
jamal.ops: +1. alternative lightweight approach: router does a one-off probe to enrichment endpoint on webhook receipt; if it returns 202 + ETA header then extend TTL by min(ETA,30s). avoids changing HS workflows.
olivia.eng: engineering note: both are doable. low-friction plan: implement router-side buffer with a feature-flag `retry_buffer_v1`. behavior: on webhook with `defer_for_enrich=true` or when probe indicates in-progress, hold up to 45s, recheck every 5s, then fallback. will instrument metrics: retry_buffer_depth, retry_buffer_recovered, retry_buffer_timeout_count.
kevin.sdr: from SDR side we must hide buffered leads from inbox to avoid accidental claims. auto-set owner=unassigned and add digest for >10m items.
mike.salesops: will update HS workflow: set `defer_for_enrich=true` and `owner=unassigned` for webhooks triggered by marketing campaigns. also set enrich webhook to flip `enrich_status=done` and call `/router/replay`. will test in dev sandbox.
jamal.ops: please ensure alerts if >1% of todays leads hit buffer >45s. also add dashboard with manual_claims_per_hour to verify reduction.
olivia.eng: I'll open PR with feature-flag and include canary deploy plan. target canary tomorrow 10:30 PT. lead-router-bot tag for deploy status please.
lead-router-bot: deploy queued: retry-buffer-v1 by olivia.eng 1 status pending. :construction:
emma.marketing: thanks all. post-canary well monitor: percent recovered to RR, buffer timeout rate, and manual_claim delta. add playbook note: "Buffered leads may delay assignment up to 45s; SDRs should wait for enrich_status=done or >15m before manual claim." :white_check_mark:
